label: Impeccable
changes: Adds shaping guidance to independent concept generation.
Adds critique and audit lenses to the review stage.
Adds polish guidance after reconciliation, never before it.
Adds no executable detector: the hook and engine layer is off and is a separate, explicit decision.

detector.requires: an explicit, separately confirmed operator action on the design-sources settings page
detector.networkBehaviour: The upstream launcher downloads a platform engine binary from the project's GitHub release channel into ~/.impeccable/bin/<version>/ when it is not already present, verified against a .sha256 sidecar and failing closed when that sidecar is missing. FDE performs no such download and vendors no launcher.
detector.hooks: Upstream ships a Claude plugin hook manifest that runs the launcher on PostToolUse (Edit|Write) and on Stop. FDE installs no hook manifest, and an upstream hook could not bypass FDE plan, write, publication or deployment approval if one were installed.
